title: Notice regarding Special Court on 28.10.2026 at 02:30 PM
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 26/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 28.10.2026 ;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 26/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
It is hereby notified that on 28.10.2026 ;
1. Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.S.Supehia and Hon’ble Ms. Justice
Vaibhavi D. Nanavati would sit in Special Division Bench
and take up the notified matters at 02:30 PM.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble Mr.
Justice A.S.Supehia and Hon’ble Ms. Justice Nisha M.
Thakore would sit in Regular Division Bench and take up
the matters as per Roster.
3. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble Ms.
Justice Vaibhavi D. Nanavati would sit Single and take up
the matters as per Roster.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
